seed_rationale: first seed of the manuscript's seed list (2..6); fixed in advance, never changed after seeing results

protocol.threshold_selection: validation only (fpr_cap objective, as in original config)
protocol.model_selection: best validation ROC-AUC checkpoint over exactly 30 rounds (early stopping disabled to obtain a fixed-length curve)
protocol.exogenous_streams: network (seed+3000) and failure/malicious (seed+2000) generators are independent of model state; equality of traces between DP and no-DP runs is verified after the fact (scripts/phase6a/compare_traces.py)

rules: No hyperparameter, noise multiplier, clip norm, architecture or seed is changed after inspecting any outcome.
A failed run is preserved with its log and reported with its cause; it is not silently retried with different settings.
Single seed: functional/diagnostic evidence only, not a statistical comparison and not a validated privacy trade-off.
